name: Dumbbell lateral raise

phases.name: raise
phases.cue: Raise your arms out to the sides

formTips: Stand tall with a dumbbell by each thigh and a soft bend in your elbows
Lead with your elbows and raise your arms out to the sides
Stop when your arms are level with your shoulders
Lower slowly over two or three seconds
Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears
commonMistakes: Swinging the body to heave the weights up
Shrugging the shoulders up towards the ears
Raising the hands far above shoulder height
Going too heavy and bending the elbows into a row
